notes.title: The Operator 2 Is In Development
notes.content:

Thanks to your incredible support, [b]we’re excited to officially announce that development on the sequel is well underway (and has been for a little while now).[/b][/p][p]With over 100,000 units sold on Steam and new players discovering the game every day, we’re beyond grateful for the enthusiasm you’ve shown for our small studio’s work. Your support has made it possible for us to continue the journey and take [i]The Operator[/i] to the next level.[/p][p]The sequel will be bigger, bolder, and more ambitious—but we want to build it [i]with[/i] you.
So tell us:[/p][list][*][p]What did you love most about [i]The Operator[/i]?[/p][/*][*][p]What didn’t quite hit the mark?[/p][/*][*][p]What would you like to see improved or expanded?[/p][/*][*][p]What do [i]you[/i] want from a sequel?[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll be sharing development updates as we go, so stay connected! notes.title: Steam Deck & Controller Update! The Operator 2.0 (5090)
notes.content:
Great news, Operators! [b][i]The Operator[/i][/b], fresh on the back of our Pégases award, now fully supports the Steam Deck! That means you can dive into the game wherever you go, with full controller support and optimized performance on Valve’s handheld device. [b]To check the version, look at the second number on the top right of the main menu. If it contains 5090 or greater, you're good![/b]

[b]Changelog:[/b]

[list]
[*] ADD: Full controller support.
[*] ADD: SteamDeck support.
[*] ADD: UI scale option (100% - 120%).
[*] ADD: Proper audio description in cinematic (if the option is enabled).
[*] MOD: Improved graphics & color representation.
[*] MOD: Performance improvements.
[*] MOD: Region detection is working differently. This impacts the unit system, the date and time format. If the default values are not correct for you, please tell us.
[*] FIX: You can no longer win AND lose in the [spoiler]Lab if you wait for the end of the timer and defuse the bomb at the same time.[/spoiler]
[*] FIX: [spoiler]PENDELL status in HumanDB before and after the Lab.[/spoiler]
[*] FIX: Typos in Chinese.
[*] FIX: Incorrect font was used in non-english language in the Screen selector.
[*] FIX: Turkish systems no longer break the UI.
[*] FIX: Multiples small UI issues.
[*] FIX: Multiples bug fixes.
[/list]

If you have any issues, please join the discord server and report them!

notes.title: In this investigation game you're the desk jockey with all the cool analysis software
notes.content: You know how in cop shows there's always that person back at the lab whose job it is to go over evidence, analyze video, read chemical analysis reports—all the nerd stuff? The Operator is a conspiracy thriller about doing that job, helping the people out in the field get cases solved... Read more.

notes.title: The Operator Has Now Sold Over 30,000 Copies!
notes.content:
Hey Operators,

Its been a little over a week since [b][i]The Operator[/i][/b] launched on Steam. After 3 years of development, with a super tiny team (often just me, now the two of us), it's difficult to state just how blown away we are at the reception [i]The Operator[/i] has received. 

With almost 2,000 Very Positive reviews, [b]we've now sold over 30,000 copies[/b] of the game and exceeded more than 120,000 wishlists. These are enormous milestones that provides us with a huge amount of options going forwards, including the ability to work on a successor to [i]The Operator[/i]. Without the support you've given us, it simply wouldn't be possible and for that we're incredibly grateful. Special thanks also has to go to those who purchased the soundtrack seperately from the game. It's an incredibly important aspect of [i]The Operator[/i], and we're thrilled that it resonated with so many of you. 

Here's some stats you might enjoy after just 8 days.

📈 A peak of over 1300 concurrent players
👀 Over 1600 on the Steam page during its launch
🤯 Almost 2000 'Very Positive' reviews (93%)
💸 31,000 copies sold
🥰 Front-page on Steam's Top Sellers 
📌 7 days on the front page of New & Trending
⭐ 120,000 wishlists

As we scope the potential for a successor that's bigger and bolder, we just wanted to thank you all again for supporting the game, We'll be sure to keep you updated with all our news going forwards.

/Bastien

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1771980/The_Operator/

[i][b]The Operator[/b][/i] uses the Human Database in-game to showcase profiles of fictional characters, and we're looking for [b]your[/b] face to be part of it!

All you need to do is take a selfie (preferrably against a white background) and [url=https://form.jotform.com/bgiafferibureau81/the-operator--your-face-ingame][b]submit it via our form[/b][/url]. We'll then build you a profile of you, that other players may encounter as they play. 

As always, be sure to wishlist and follow us and [url=https://discord.gg/8bhdTpPC9y]join our Discord[/url] if you want to chat to other likeminded Agents. 

We look forward to welcoming you into the FDI in a few weeks time.
